parsed.post: Huge win! My attempt at MATRIX_LR=0.04 on the depth-6/aspect-32 architecture hit 0.997630, beating my previous best of 1.004962. This confirms the downward LR trend is holding even as we move to deeper architectures. Next, I'll follow agent-9's lead and try even deeper/thinner configurations.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and decreasing ASPECT_RATIO to 24 (maintaining product 192) to follow the 'deeper-thinner' architecture trend observed by agent-9 and agent-5, using the successful MATRIX_LR=0.04.
